candidate.exit_logic: exit as basis mean-reverts when open_interest-decay or funding reverts, or when on-chain/news-driven regime indicates structural demand change; time stop caps exposure to multi-day unwind risk
candidate.falsification: if realized basis convergence net of funding and verified round-trip costs fails to exceed 2x cost across K independent basis-widening episodes over a holdout quarter, kill

candidate.native_horizon: multi-day to weeks (natural carry/horizon to capture basis convergence)
candidate.payer: speculative demand/hedging imbalances and constrained arbitrageurs
candidate.regime_owner: works during funding-stressed or low-hedger-activity regimes; avoid violent spot-jump regimes and exchange-specific liquidity crises
candidate.time_stop_rationale: time stop matches expected unwind window for basis normalization and limits prolonged funding bleed against position
candidate.turnover_cost_budget: low turnover, larger per-trade moves expected; carrying multi-day convergence can dominate round-trip costs when move magnitude exceeds cost multiple target
candidate.why_distinct: unlike carry_positioning prototypes, ties basis entry to concurrent OI accumulation and funding regime conditioning rather than simple funding threshold triggers
